title: PortXR catalogue entry
description: games/<slug>/meta.json: how a game plays in VR with PortXR, in each display mode, who tried it, what goes wrong, and the files that fix it. What a game needs (nothing, settings or a script) is read from `files`.

mode.description: Full VR: the game's world around you. 3D screen: the game in 3D on a big screen. VR screen: the flat game on a big screen.

rating.description: perfect: nothing to fix. good: small issues you can ignore. playable: noticeable issues, still finishable. broken: not playable yet.

game.description: The game's name as its store page writes it.

slug.description: The folder name and the page address. Never changes once published.

steamAppId.description: The number in the game's Steam store address. PortXR matches the game by it, and the site shows Steam's picture of the game. Required for Steam games.

engineVersion.description: As PortXR shows it on the game's page: 2021.3, 5.4, 4.3.

exe.description: The game's exe, which names its scripts folder. Unreal games: the <Game>-Win64-Shipping.exe. PortXR matches games without a Steam ID by it.

author.description: GitHub name of whoever looks after the entry.

version.description: Version of this entry. Raise it with every change to its files: PortXR offers the new files as an update.

ratings.description: How well the game plays in each display mode someone tried. Each mode here needs a report in that mode.

issues.description: What goes wrong, each with a short note. Empty when nothing does.

mode.description: Only in this mode. Left out: in every mode tried.

reports.description: Each time someone played it and said how it went. Newest first.

headset.description: Headset and how it connects: Quest 3 (Virtual Desktop), Valve Index (SteamVR).

withFiles.description: Played with this entry's files. Left out: as it is.

issue.description: The GitHub issue the report came from.

hasOnlineMultiplayer.description: The game has an online mode. The entry is still for single-player only.

hasAntiCheat.description: Games with anti-cheat are not accepted.

containsCode.description: True when any file is a Lua script.

files.description: Empty when the game plays as it is.

notes.description: The short story: what works, what does not, what the files fix. Plain text.

sample.description: A made-up entry that shows the format. Removed before the catalogue opens.
